description.value: Beacon Pub & Eatery is a craft beer and comfort food pub located in the heart of Whistler Village Square, with what the venue describes as the best patio and après vibe in town. The menu leans into hearty fare — Canadian beef and bison burgers, poutine, wings, and loaded tacos — designed to refuel after a full day on the trails or slopes. The venue operates on a first-come, first-served basis with a 90-minute dining limit, so arriving early is advisable during peak periods.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (16 spaces) at 96m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed food menu, contact, and location information. Vegetarian options (veggie burger, falafel mezze, butternut squash bruschetta) and gluten-free buns are explicitly listed on the eating page. No bike parking, bike racks, washroom references, Wi-Fi, or takeout/water refill mentions appear anywhere in the website content. Two inconsistent addresses appear across website pages ('Village Green' vs 'Village Stroll'; postal codes 'V8E 1H1' vs 'V0N 1B4'); the dedicated contact page is treated as authoritative ('Village Stroll, V8E 1H1').
concerns: Inconsistent address across website pages: front page and features page footer use '4154 Village Green' while contact page and structured footer use '4154 Village Stroll'; postal code also varies between 'V8E 1H1' and 'V0N 1B4'. Contact page value ('Village Stroll, V8E 1H1') used as authoritative.
OSM record contains no address or phone — these fields populated entirely from website; contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address set to null as there is no OSM value to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established pub and eatery in the centre of Whistler Village with a substantial food menu suited to post-ride refuelling; a useful listing for touring cyclists passing through Whistler.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free buns available for all handhelds; vegetarian options include a garden black bean veggie burger, Mediterranean mezze with warm falafel, and butternut squash bruschetta
